title: TransportOrderRated
description: The TMS rated an accepted Transport Order: its Freight Charge is calculated and frozen (Canonical Model event, version 1). Published on the Transport Order events topic, under the correlation ID of the Transport Order's intake, or of the re-rate that rated it.

occurredAt.description: When the Transport Order was rated.

shipperId.description: The Shipper whose Rate Card priced the Transport Order.

freightCharge.description: The price Norvia charges the Shipper for the Transport Order, without VAT.

total.description: The sum of the charge lines.

type.description: What the line charges for: always a Freight line, and a Minimum charge adjustment line when the Lane's minimum charge applies.

amount.description: Rounded to cents, half away from zero.

rateCardVersion.description: The version of the Shipper's Rate Card the Freight Charge was calculated from: the one valid on the collection date.
